comparisonAvailable.description: Whether the server can present a pre/post comparison for this outcome.

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

epistemicState.description: The outcome's epistemic state — an executed outcome becomes OBSERVED only through post-work evidence, never by implication.

outcomeId.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

postWorkEvidenceContentIds.description: Content ids of the post-work evidence supporting this outcome.

items.description: sha-256 content address (64 lowercase hex). Normative derivation: the frozen AISE-CONTENT-V1 canonical encoding (see apps/android ContentIdentity).

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, `Z` suffix only.
